ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
StrainDesign is a COBRApy-based package for the computational design of
metabolic networks. It provides standard and advanced tools for the analysis
and redesign of biological networks, including minimal cut sets, OptKnock,
RobustKnock and OptCouple, built on a common mixed-integer linear programming
core. Computations can be run with GLPK, SCIP, CPLEX or Gurobi.

The conda package is named straindesign-cobra to avoid a clash with the
unrelated straindesign package on bioconda; the PyPI project and the Python
import name are straindesign.
about.summary: Computational strain design package for the COBRApy framework

name: straindesign-cobra
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.19.1"

package:
  name: straindesign-cobra
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/s/straindesign/straindesign-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: e3a51ac978e07b124ddc07595b421d4cfea0c976b03426800a22948927384489

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77
    - wheel
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - cobra
    - matplotlib-base
    - numpy
    - optlang
    - pandas
    - psutil
    - pyscipopt
    - scipy
    - swiglpk

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - straindesign
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/klamt-lab/straindesign
  summary: Computational strain design package for the COBRApy framework
  description: |
    StrainDesign is a COBRApy-based package for the computational design of
    metabolic networks. It provides standard and advanced tools for the analysis
    and redesign of biological networks, including minimal cut sets, OptKnock,
    RobustKnock and OptCouple, built on a common mixed-integer linear programming
    core. Computations can be run with GLPK, SCIP, CPLEX or Gurobi.

    The conda package is named straindesign-cobra to avoid a clash with the
    unrelated straindesign package on bioconda; the PyPI project and the Python
    import name are straindesign.
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  documentation: https://straindesign.readthedocs.io/
  repository: https://github.com/klamt-lab/straindesign

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - VonAlphaBisZulu
